mapper.select: SELECT loan_account_id, repayment_account_id FROM loan_account WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT loan_principal_balance, loan_status_id FROM loan_account WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}

SELECT la.loan_principal_balance -- 이자 미납 + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rs.scheduled_interest - rs.paid_interest), 0) FROM repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id IN (#{due}, #{paid}, #{overdue})) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.carried_interest - a.paid_carried_interest), 0) FROM loan_acceleration a WHERE a.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(adc.interest_amount - adc.paid_interest), 0) FROM acceleration_daily_charge adc JOIN loan_acceleration a ON a.loan_acceleration_id = adc.loan_acceleration_id WHERE a.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.carried_interest - m.paid_carried_interest), 0) FROM loan_maturity_overdue m WHERE m.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) -- 연체금 미납 + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(idc.delinquency_charge - idc.paid_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM installment_delinquency_charge idc JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.repayment_schedule_id = idc.repayment_schedule_id WHERE rs.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id IN (#{due}, #{paid}, #{overdue})) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.carried_delinquency_charge - a.paid_carried_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM loan_acceleration a WHERE a.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(adc.delinquency_charge - adc.paid_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM acceleration_daily_charge adc JOIN loan_acceleration a ON a.loan_acceleration_id = adc.loan_acceleration_id WHERE a.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.carried_delinquency_charge - m.paid_carried_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM loan_maturity_overdue m WHERE m.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mdc.delinquency_charge - mdc.paid_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM maturity_overdue_daily_charge mdc JOIN loan_maturity_overdue m ON m.loan_maturity_overdue_id = mdc.loan_maturity_overdue_id WHERE m.loan_account_id = la.loan_account_id) FROM loan_account la WHERE la.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_account (loan_contract_id, repayment_account_id, account_no, loan_status_id, loan_principal_balance, monthly_payment_day) VALUES (#{loanContractId}, #{repaymentAccountId}, #{accountNo}, #{loanStatusId}, #{loanPrincipalBalance}, #{monthlyPaymentDay})
